#The Red Year

When Red Mountain woke, Vvardenfell burned, and the ash came down on Solstheim like black snow. House Redoran gave Raven Rock to the refugees, and the refugees gave it the stubbornness Raven Rock still has.

We built the Bulwark against the ash storms. It mostly works.

#Ash Spawn

On bad nights, shapes walk out of the ash: grey, crumbling, angry. The guard calls them ash spawn and fights them on the wall.

Nobody knows what they are. The Temple says they are the restless dead of the eruption. I think they are what happens when a land is buried too deep to forget.
